data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001 names 'integration' but reduces to the same "removes trace → still detectable" obstacle that SRC_004 raises; it never identifies a distinct integrative mechanism (e.g., a shared interface or dependency between the isolation method and the blind-spot theory). Because the refutation hinges only on residual fingerprints re-triggering the checker, the stated relation is interchangeable with incompatibility, so the 'integration' label is unsupported by the content.
